templates.name: Universal Thinking Guides (for projects with no track spec)
templates.description: Track-independent thinking guides: reuse, cross-layer work, and separating reporting from deciding. **Install this only for a project that has no track spec yet** — a track template already ships the same guides, and a project can install exactly one template.

templates.name: Web Fullstack (Next.js 16 + Supabase)
templates.description: Coding rules for Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/Base UI + Supabase (RLS) + Vitest/Playwright + Docker. **Ships the track-independent guides**, so one init installs everything.

templates.name: Java Stack (Spring Boot 4 + Postgres + shadcn-admin-kit)
templates.description: Coding rules for Spring Boot 4 + Postgres/Flyway + Spring Security sessions + React 19/Vite/Tailwind v4/shadcn-admin-kit (ra-core), deployed as a single container with the SPA packaged into the jar. **There is no RLS**, so isolation rests on owner-scoped queries, ArchUnit and two-account negative tests instead. **Ships the track-independent guides**, so one init installs everything.
